WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(t.tradekind, 'No Type') AS tradekind,
    COUNT(*) AS type_count
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY COALESCE(t.tradekind, 'No Type')
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(type_count) AS total_count,
    AVG(type_count) AS avg_count
  FROM type_counts
)
SELECT 
  tc.tradekind,
  tc.type_count,
  CAST(tc.type_count AS NUMERIC) / t.total_count AS proportion,
  tc.type_count - t.avg_count AS count_minus_avg
FROM type_counts tc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE tc.type_count > t.avg_count
  AND t.avg_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY tc.tradekind
